subject: Saturday practice moved to Field 3, new time 9am
body: Hi parents, due to field maintenance on Field 1, this Saturday's U10 practice is moving to Field 3 and starting at 9:00am instead of 10:00am. Same day, just a new location and time. See you there! - Coach Miller

subject: Question about Emma's reading log
body: Hi, I noticed Emma hasn't turned in her reading log for the last two weeks. Could you let me know if everything is okay at home, or reply so we can figure out a plan together? Thanks, Ms. Chen

subject: Fall registration is now open
body: Registration for the fall chess club season is now open. Spots are limited to 20 students. Sign up online whenever you're ready - no rush, registration stays open through the end of September.

subject: Your cart is waiting - complete your order

subject: Important update

subject: You have 3 new connection suggestions

subject: RSVP needed: End of season party Sept 20

subject: Update

subject: Great game today!
